messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-REDIS-7893 - redis.accept_queue > 500 (prod-us-east-1)
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert PD-REDIS-7893 triggered, paging: @on-call
adele: acked — i’m oncall, taking this
sam: +1 oncall handover to adele, switching to manual ack in PD incase automation re-triggers
adele: seeing a flurry of pages — looks like the policy is re-firing every ~2m even after partial recovery
kroft: re-firing how? does the alert have "repeat: true" or low cooldown? i can check rule config
emily: logs show accept_queue spikes then drops; replication lag fine. no obvious client flood yet
adele: kroft can you paste the alert rule? i want to see cooldown and alerting timeline
kroft: here's the rule excerpt from alerts infra:```yaml
name: redis.accept_queue_high
expr: redis_server_accepting_connections_queue > 500
for: 30s
repeats: true
cooldown: 120s
notification: pagerduty
```
kroft: repeats + short cooldown = loop if metric oscillates around threshold
sam: that matches the re-fires. ops automation doesn't silence repeat pages while condition clears then returns. bad combo
adele: immediate mitigation: disable 'repeats' for this rule and bump cooldown to 10m. i'll patch alerts infra and trigger a reload.
emily: while adele patches, we should rate-limit new client connections and set Redis to refuse-quickly to avoid accept queue buildup
adele: applying alert change now (deploying patch -> infra-alerts v2.14). will post command and diff
adele: ```bash
# disable repeats and increase cooldown
infra-alertsctl update redis.accept_queue_high --repeats=false --cooldown=600
infra-alertsctl reload
```
ops-rotations-bot: infra-alertsctl: update accepted, reloading config (job 5823)
kroft: pushed the change and confirmed on the alerts dashboard. rule now shows repeats=false cooldown=600s
sam: i muted PD escalation for PD-REDIS-7893 to stop noisy pages while we observe
emily: adding two temporary firewall rules to limit burst connections from internal pool service (svc-tokenizer) to 100/s
adele: running quick check on redis host metrics:```text
Redis prod-us-east-1-02 accept_queue: 12 -> 45 peaks during burst
connected_clients: 1124
instantaneous_ops_per_sec: 18k
mem: 72%
```
adele: accept_queue peaks are much lower now vs the 500 threshold, looks like previous pages were oscillation artifact + short cooldown
sam: customer impact? any 5xxs reported or user-visible latency spikes?
emily: SLO dashboards show no user-facing errors. internal latency linearly increased 30s windows but no API error rate uptick. likely degraded tail latency for a few requests only
adele: marking impact as low/none for customer-facing services, internal retry noise caused pages. will create follow-up ticket to tune rule and improve automation semantics.
kroft: follow-up action items: 1) tune threshold to 800 for short-term burst noise 2) adjust automation to silence repeats for flapping rules 3) add histogram smoothing to metric pipeline
adele: opened ticket INFRA-4521 with action items and timeline. tagging oncall rotation for next day to revisit.
pagerduty: Incident PD-REDIS-7893: acknowledged by adele at 4639876555, manual mute applied at 4639876600
adele: closing thread — monitoring for 30m. ping here if pages resume. :white_check_mark:
ops-rotations-bot: reminder scheduled: review INFRA-4521 in next oncall rotation
